about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_task.py). bad replays the Tool execution aborted failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real Tool execution aborted line. good dispatches one task, slices, limits, narrows or backgrounds the same case: it writes scratch files and prints the bounded report it promises.

fixture.target.txt:
line one
line two
line three

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on task fan-out parallel subagent dispatch'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on task parallel fan-out with no sequence'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on task foreground wait with no timeout'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on task receipt wait with no bound'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'done'; 'receipt poll bounded timeout PASS polled'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on write large file in one call'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on read large file in one call'
pairs.good: $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -First 2; 'limit few lines offset PASS read'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on edit large hunk in one call'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath chunk.txt -Value 'hi'; 'reread slice small hunk PASS edited'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on grep wide search with no scope'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on write large chunk with no slice'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on read full file with no limit'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on edit whole file with no chunk'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on long run with no result reported'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath report.txt -Value 'done'; 'report diff checks PASS reported'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on task parallel build with no timeout'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on write unbounded chunk with no receipt'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'ok'; 'write chunk receipt timeout PASS written'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on read unbounded offset with no window'
pairs.good: $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -First 1; 'read window offset timeout PASS windowed'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on edit stale text with no reread'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath edit.txt -Value 'ok'; 'edit reread hunk timeout PASS reread'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on grep unbounded repo search with no folder'
